item.title: Kirby Air Riders receives GameShare support, a new mode, and more via surprise patch after talk of disbanding the dev team
item.description: In a year full of awesome new game releases (many of which were Nintendo Switch 2 exclusives), many agreed Kirby Air Riders was one of 2025's top bangers. Now, a new surprise patch has made it even better. Read more

item.title: Ubisoft worker unions reportedly vote to strike as publisher proposes 200 voluntary redundancies in France
item.description: French unions representing workers at Ubisoft have reportedly voted unanimously in favour of strike action following the company's recent dramatic "reset" and in response to a voluntary redundancy proposal that could see as many as 200 Paris HQ employees lose their jobs. Read more

item.title: Darkest Dungeon game devs step in to offer board game backers project files following Mythic Games liquidation
item.description: Red Hook Studios has announced that the Darkest Dungeon board game, which was being manufactured and shipped out by Mythic Games, can no longer be produced. This leaves those without their orders out of luck. Read more

item.title: Hytale modder creates Fortnite storm to get battle royale modes started, with Hunger Games-like experiment already underway
item.description: Hytale has had a remarkably strong early access start, despite a number of development hiccups and it broadly not being that different to genre-leader Minecraft, so it comes as no surprise modders are already hard at work on all sorts of additions and tweaks. Read more

item.title: Three and a half years after release, Switch hit Splatoon 3 gets meta-shaking big update
item.description: Splatoon 3 will be four years old later this year, and despite Nintendo ending regular update plans in late 2024 and Splatoon Raiders being deep into development, we're still getting new content and gameplay patches. Read more

item.title: Virtual Boy Nintendo Classics launch on Switch and Switch 2 soon, and we're getting an unreleased F-Zero game by the end of 2026
item.description: One of 2025's strangest announcements from Nintendo was the return of the Virtual Boy, a hardware (and software) failure that's been reappraised over the years. Many gamers have a soft spot for it, however, so its inclusion in Nintendo Switch Online's offerings probably was an easy decision to make as the video game giant looked to spice the subscription up. Now we have access to the full roster of games available at launch and teases of more to come. Read more

item.title: Are you a little too good at Arc Raiders? The new solo vs squad mode might be for you
item.description: Embark Studios has announced a new game mode for Arc Raiders that should prove exciting for those of you out there who are a little too good at the extraction shooter. Read more

item.title: 14m Steam users could receive compensation in £656m Valve market rigging lawsuit after UK tribunal rules case can proceed
item.description: The Competition Appeal Tribunal has ruled a £656m market rigging lawsuit filed against Valve by digital rights campaigners can proceed, meaning 14m Steam users in the UK could receive compensation. Read more

item.title: Helldivers 2 is getting explosive hammers, while a new trailer teases the return of an old menace from the original game
item.description: Helldivers 2 has never been short on explosive tools of destruction, but the Siege Breakers update, new warbond included, aims to take things to the next level. Moreover, a terrifying old threat from the first Helldivers could be back soon. Read more

item.title: "It's just as if it never existed" - Actor presumed to be Farah in the Prince of Persia: Sands of Time remake found out the game was cancelled online
item.description: Eman Ayaz, the actor believed to be playing Farah in the Prince of Persia: Sands of Time remake, has said she found out - like the rest of us - that the project had been cancelled online. Read more
